{{Quote|Anakin, they're ''not'' droids...! They're ''Humans''&mdash;in some sort of ''armor''!''"<br />"''Very ''perceptive'', Master Jedi! The Humans serve as living ''bio-batteries'' for the droid bodies! And how can you stop the droids... without destroying the ''Humans within''?!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Doctor Blayne, on Blayne's [[Blayne's droid|bio-droids]]|<ref name="Mask of Iron">{{TCWComicCite|6.44|Mask of Iron}}</ref>}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Blayne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who operated from an [[Blayne's asteroid base|asteroid base]] during the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Blayne developed a type of [[Blayne's liquid metal|liquid metal]] that could be used to encapsulate [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings and turn them into [[Blayne's droid|living droids]]. Hoping to profit from the substance, Blayne contacted the criminal [[Shorran Dak]] to arrange a deal for the sale of the metal for use as a form of weaponry. However, Dak was [[Mission to Blayne's asteroid base|captured]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] while en-route to Blayne's base and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived at the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in his place, posing as Dak and his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. Blayne suspected that the pair were connected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] authorities, and after welcoming the Jedi into his facility, he had some of his living [[Droid/Legends|droids]] turn on Skywalker, so as to demonstrate their effectiveness as a weapon. Kenobi and Skywalker revealed themselves to be Jedi and Blayne deactivated some of the droids, to enable the liquid metal to leave them and smother Skywalker, which gave Blayne full control of the Jedi's movements. Blayne briefly set Skywalker against Kenobi, but the two Jedi soon overcame the metal and Kenobi covered Blayne with the substance instead, transforming into a bio-droid who served the Jedi.
